modules.name: Complaint Management
modules.description: Lets Raghuvir Admin view, assign and monitor complaints across projects, categories and statuses.

requirements.title: Admin dashboard of complaints
requirements.description: When the Raghuvir Admin opens the dashboard, the system shows complaints by project, category and status.

requirements.title: Assign builder complaint to a person
requirements.description: The Raghuvir Admin can assign a builder complaint, and the system notifies the Assigned Person.

requirements.title: Delayed complaints list
requirements.description: The Raghuvir Admin can open a delayed list showing complaints that are past their time limit.
